svg.title: What each WebUI page extracts
svg.desc: A matrix of the structured blocks, Unity classes and indexes each export.bat page extracts with --from-game, and a diagram of which pages read another page's published output: each arrow points from the page that publishes the data to the page that reads it.
svg.text: export.bat PAGE --from-game exports the union of the named pages' inputs. Every cell is declared per build task in scripts/webui/pages.py.
required: must exist and be current
read when present, else the page degrades
read when present; another mode or page extracts it
shown as files by the Data page
story extracts text only; story-media adds its images and videos; voice lines come from Audio. Data shows every output the other pages do not, undecoded blocks as bytes.
No page named (every column) extracts the same as debug. Asset maps are refreshed by every Unity export; MonoBehaviour and PlayableDirector are exported together with the object index.
Which pages read another page's output
A page builds only itself and never writes another page's files. What it shows from another page is whatever that page last published.
Arrows follow the data: A → B means B reads what A published. The arrowhead is always the reader.
B's builder reads the files A published under webui/data.
In one export.bat run A builds first. When B is built alone,
it uses A's last publication, or goes without it.
B's page fetches the files A published while you browse.
Build order does not matter: B shows the data
once A has been built, and omits it until then.
story: lang/CN conv, missions, actors, index
A full run builds each page after the pages its dashed arrows come from: Story and Assets, then Characters, Map and Gameplay, then Audio.
Updates compares two complete exports (build_updates.bat OLD NEW) and is not part of export.bat.
